## MEXICO — profile (page 191)

- **Header facts:** Region: Latin America & the Caribbean; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: IBRD; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 131.9 million; GNI: 1,776,305; Unit: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 645,042, **+7.9% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Printed start/end values are **538,015** (2015) and **645,042** (2025). The line rises from 2015 through the late 2010s, peaks around **≈2020–21**, then declines **≈2022–23**, is broadly flat **≈2024**, and rises sharply in 2025 to the period-end high.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 645,042
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed (PPG):** 341,734
    - **Private nonguaranteed (PNG):** 241,231
    - **Short-term:** 62,077
  - **PPG — by creditor type:** 341,734
    - **Multilateral:** 41,895
    - **Bilateral:** 3,010
    - **Private creditors:** 296,830
  - **Multilateral:** 41,895
    - **IMF-SDR allocations:** 15,604
    - **World Bank-IBRD:** 13,465
    - **Other multilateral:** 12,826
  - **Bilateral:** 3,010
    - **France:** 1,853
    - **Germany:** 1,078
    - **Other bilateral:** 78

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**
  - **External debt / exports:** **86%**, **+1.1%**. Trend: broadly low and fairly flat, with a small mid-period bump, then easing and a slight uptick by 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** **36%**, **+8.1%**. Trend: rises in the first half of the period, dips after a local peak around the early 2020s, then edges up by 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** **10%**, **-7.3%**. Trend: volatile; early spike, decline, partial rebound, drop, then little change near the end.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** **4%**, **-0.9%**. Trend: rises sharply early, then fluctuates downward and stabilizes around 4% by 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **16 yrs**; Grace period **4 yrs**; Interest rate **5.5%**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **13 yrs**; Grace period **8 yrs**; Interest rate **4.8%**

- **Notes:** Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries.
- **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
